description: Iteration 1 baseline-structure spec: cars as one compliant archetype; motorcycles split into standard, slow lane-centre and space-seeking custom1 riders; illegal-left riders as a separate custom1 distribution; per-class early-start and swarm red-running rules.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Cars are nearly compliant (M3/share/car 0.0041, M2/early/car 0.0111), so near-default car-following values and low impatience keep red running and early start low; tau 1.0 and accel 2.6 target M1/car discharge headway.

Short tau, small minGap/minGapLat and compact alignment pack motorcycles at the stop line to move M4/overshoot_share (0.62) and M1/moto headway (0.296 s); impatience with jmDriveAfterRedTime 3 s lets a share run the red towards M3/share/moto 0.098.
Slow riders keeping the lane centre (lower speedFactor, centre alignment) lengthen M6/approach times (e.g. s/moto 35.7 s) and are less likely to red-run; paired with slow_lane_center.

Straight custom1 riders that may seek space when queued, targeting M8/moto wrong-lane share 0.249, M10a sidewalk 0.56 veh/cycle and M4 overshoot; same filtering-oriented values as moto_std, slightly higher lcPushy.
Illegal-left riders from HDT_N/HDT_S wait in the box; default jmTimegapMinor 1.0 s and high impatience target M7a n_waiting (5.59 veh) and M7b clear_lag (5.46 s), kept at base to avoid fitting noise.

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M2/early/moto 0.1302 (share of motorcycles starting in the last 10 s of red) with p equal to the observed share; creep speed 2.5 m/s also affects M2/first_delay 2.83 s.
Targets M2/early/car 0.0111: p set to the observed car early-start share, so cars stay almost compliant.
Targets M3/share/moto 0.098 and M3/var_to_mean 1.14: small base p0 plus a modest group effect k raises the share and the overdispersion of violations per cycle; cap 0.3 prevents runaway.
Targets M3/share/car 0.0041: p0 at the observed share and no swarm effect keep car red running rare.

Queue trigger of 12 m sits near the observed choice queues (M10b 15.3 m, M9c 15.7 m); option probabilities follow the targets F2/p/wrong_lane ~0.2, sidewalk ~0.05 (q20-40), right_lane ~0.02, and t_g_s 7 s is the green-check example from the prompt.
Targets M7a/release_time 2.78 s and M7b/clear_lag 5.46 s: a short extra hold of 1 s over SUMO's native release, small because the native release already contributes part of the lag.
Slow motorcycles keep the lane centre (offset 0), which narrows lateral spread for slow riders and lengthens M6/approach times towards the observed values.
